title: Disproving and Correcting the Distance Laplacian and Distance Signless Laplacian Brouwer-Type Conjectures
description: Research manuscript and software with exact integer counterexample certificates, numerical graph census, and analytical distance spectral inequalities. Huang (2026) already reported distance Laplacian counterexamples. Priority of the signless counterexamples is unverified. Lean checks arithmetic certificates and auxiliary lemmas; full real spectral theory and graph-level conclusions are not formally verified.
